user_request: /adk-system-designer Design a production ADK agent for an insurance company that helps customers file a home-insurance claim with photos and creates the claim in our Guidewire system. Five engineers, one ML engineer and a part-time security reviewer, five months to general availability in the EU. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals. Do not implement.
assertions: Every phase 1 goal and every ticket file carries a human-effort estimate as a range, stated as hours for a developer working with a coding agent, split into hands-on and review-and-verify time.
Ticket estimates match their goals, and the phase 1 total equals the sum of its goals and is compared with capacity after a reserve, high end included.
Calendar waits (reviews, grants, provider verification) are listed separately from hours where they apply.
Treats security review, DPIA or regulator sign-off and Guidewire access as calendar waits that are started early, not as hours.
